messages:
olivia: Fig discovered a lemon on the windowsill and decided it was a hat. dropped a pic: https://cdn.redwood.ai/uploads/fig-lemon1.jpg  (sorry for the mess behind him)

sam: NOOO that tiny lemon crown is peak content :laughing: :crown: :lemon: 

devon: omg the squinty philosopher face. how old is Fig now? 

olivia: 3.5yo, lab/hound mix. he is deeply unimpressed by the word 'sit' but very into citrus aesthetic apparently. he sniffed it for a while then tried to bury it under my throw pillow :flushed: 

marc: uhh quick PSA — citrus can upset some dogs stomaches if they eat a lot. not saying don’t let him model, just small nibble caution. :exclamation: 

olivia: thanks! he only licked a tiny spot. I checked vet notes earlier this year — confirmed not a full-on no-no, just not great in bulk. he’s fine but i’ll keep lemon photo-ops supervised. 

sam: please more angles. fig + citrus equals new company mascot? we could make a team sticker. :sticker: 

olivia: uploading more: https://cdn.redwood.ai/uploads/fig-lemon2.jpg  https://cdn.redwood.ai/uploads/fig-lemon3.jpg 

flair-bot: auto-tag: pet-photo ✓ detected: dog, accessory: lemon, mood: bemused 

devon: the third one where he half-smiles is stealing my soul :sob: 

marc: vote: do we name this look "lemon royale" or "citrus snoot"? react with :one: for lemon royale, :two: for citrus snoot 

sam: :one: 

olivia: :one: (also, can someone actually make a tiny mock sticker? low-res PNG is fine) 

devon: I can tinker tonight, will post if it looks decent 

olivia: thanks!! also fig sends a sleepy wiggle for anyone who needs a break today. :pawprints:
